seo.description: Bokedex is a Pokémon encyclopedia: every Pokémon, move, ability, item and place in English and Japanese, plus team and quiz tools.
seo.homeDescription: Browse every Pokémon, filter by type and generation, and open any Pokémon for stats, evolutions, moves and where to find it.
seo.pokemonFallback: Stats, evolutions, moves and where to find {name}.

home.title: Every Pokémon, one search away.
home.lead: Browse {total} Pokémon from {generations} generations. Check type matchups, build a team of six, then test yourself in the quiz.
home.errorMessage: The data didn't load. Check your connection and try again.
home.emptyMessage: Try a different name or number, or clear a filter.

types.title: Type chart
types.description: Full Pokémon type effectiveness chart with a defensive matchup calculator.
types.lead: Pick one or two types to see what hits them hardest. Hover the grid to trace any attack against any defender.
types.matrixCaption: Damage multiplier of each attacking type (rows) against each defending type (columns)
types.detailDescription: {name} type: strengths, weaknesses, moves and Pokémon.

team.title: Team builder
team.description: Build a team of six and see its shared weaknesses and type coverage.
team.lead: Pick up to six Pokémon. Bokedex shows which attack types threaten the team and which types it can hit hard.
team.noHoles: No type threatens this team more than it resists.
team.holesHint: More of your team is weak to these types than resists them. Plan around them or add a Pokémon that resists them.
team.coverageHint: Types your team hits for super-effective damage using its own types. {covered} of {total} covered.
team.notCovered: Not covered: {types}. Teach a move of another type to fill the gap.
team.breakdownHint: Each tile shows team members weak to the type, then those that resist it.
team.emptyMessage: Add a Pokémon to see weaknesses and coverage, or start from a random team.

play.title: Play
play.description: Two quick Pokémon quizzes: name the silhouette and master the type chart.
play.lead: Quick rounds built from live Pokédex data. New Pokémon join the quiz as soon as they appear in the Pokédex.

verdict.perfect: Flawless. You are a Pokémon Master.

play.silhouetteIntro: Ten silhouettes, four names each. Keep a streak going to climb your best score.
play.typeMasterIntro: A move of one type hits a Pokémon. How much damage does it do? Ten rounds that train the type chart the games expect you to know.
